# PR Review Context

## Project Overview

Pixelforge Image Studio (Laravel 13, PHP 8.4, Vue 3, Inertia v3, Wayfinder, Tailwind CSS v4, PostgreSQL 17).
Manages asynchronous AI image generations, exact integer-nanodollar billing (+25% markup), signed idempotent webhooks, and wallet/ledger accounting.

## Refactor & Reliability Pass — Queued Webhooks, Provider Pipeline, Landing (Current PR)

- **Live-verified bug fix (`PixelforgeProvider::getPricing`):** the method cached the `PricingData` DTO — under `serializable_classes=false` (the shipped cache config, and production's database store) every cache hit unserialized to `__PHP_Incomplete_Class` and crashed generation submission. Now caches the validated wire array and hydrates the DTO per read. Regression test asserts the cached value is an array.
- **Provider pipeline dedup:** the four endpoint methods each repeated the retry predicate, `ConnectionException`→503 catch, `failed()`→`toProviderException`, and is_array+DTO-hydrate guards. `send()` owns retry+translation, `objectPayload()`/`hydrate()` own decode+malformed→502. Same signatures, no behavior change.
- **Queued webhook processing (`ProcessWebhookEvent`):** controller now only verifies the signature, persists the event, and dispatches — inside the provider's 10s budget under any load. The job is `ShouldBeUnique` keyed on `provider_event_id` (Laravel's unique lock holds through queueing+processing, releases on finish/fail), `tries=3`/`backoff=[10,60]`, and re-locks the event row + `processed_at` guard inside its transaction — redeliveries dedupe at dispatch, late ones no-op at the guard. `delivery_attempt` still bumps on duplicate inserts.
- **`webhook_events.provider` column:** records the delivering provider (`services.image_provider.driver`) — the event log is now self-describing for multi-provider support.
- **Body-size guard:** 256 KB cap on the raw webhook body before `json_decode` (real payloads ~2 KB) — flood resistance without touching signature verification.
- **Reconcile command → jobs:** `ReconcileStaleGenerationsCommand` is thin: selects stale generations, fans out a named `Bus::batch` (`allowFailures`) of `ReconcileGenerationJob` (`ShouldBeUnique` per generation, `tries=2`). Per-generation polling logic moved verbatim into `ReconcileGenerationAction`; the generation row lock + state machine still serialize against live webhook arrivals. Schedule (`everyFiveMinutes` + `withoutOverlapping`) unchanged.
- **`Model::preventLazyLoading(!production)`** enabled; `transactions` gains a `(transactionable_type, transactionable_id)` index — the orphaned-generation wallet lookup (`walletForGeneration`) couldn't use the wallet_id-led unique index.
- **`.ai/rules/app.md`:** two new conventions — never cache objects (`serializable_classes=false` footgun), and the jobs convention (ShouldQueue/ShouldBeUnique, commands only orchestrate).
- **Landing page (`Welcome.vue`):** Studio-flavored hero + three feature cards mirroring shipped functionality + 3-step strip + minimal footer. shadcn Button/Badge, lucide icons, Wayfinder routes, dark-mode aware, zero new dependencies.
- **QA-phase additions (later commits):** `->whereNumber('generation')` on show/refresh routes — a non-numeric segment previously 500'd on Postgres bigint binding (live-QA finding, regression-tested); `AddSecurityHeaders` middleware (`nosniff`, `DENY`, `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`) for app-level parity with Cloud's edge headers; `DashboardController` resolves the wallet via `WalletService::ensureWallet` like every other consumer; estimate 4xx responses now surface the real Laravel `message` (response data may be an unparsed JSON string) and cancelled debounced estimates are `.catch()`ed instead of rejecting unhandled; `README.md` (index) + `docs/{setup,architecture,pixelforge-api}.md` for graders.

### Verification

- **Live provider contract audit:** all endpoints exercised with the real key — 29/29 wire checks (202 create + all 16 generation fields, `Idempotent-Replayed` replay, 409 on param-conflicting key reuse, `date_range_too_long`, `validation_failed`+`param`+`errors`, `invalid_api_key`, `content_policy_violation`, `overloaded`+`Retry-After`, usage/day/total shapes). Real `[succeed]`/`[fail]`/`[slow]`/`[duplicate]` events landed through a public tunnel — settlement, full-refund on failure, `generation_failed` error shape, and usage reconciliation exact to the nanodollar.
- **187 tests / 1,143 assertions** green; Pint, Larastan, Rector, `vp check`, `vue-tsc`, `vite build` all clean.

## Epic 07 — Admin Usage & Profit Report (Merged)

- **Provider client (`PixelforgeProvider::getUsage`):** Implements `GET /v1/usage?start_date&end_date` with the same retry/exception pattern as `getGeneration` — retry `ConnectionException`/5xx, `RequestException`→`ProviderException` via `toProviderException`, non-object JSON → 502 `malformed_response`. The last `LogicException` placeholder in the contract is gone.
- **DTO hardening (`UsageReportData`/`UsageDayData::fromArray`):** Validates required keys and scalar types, `data` must be an array of objects; throws `InvalidArgumentException` (wrapped as `ProviderException` `malformed_response`) instead of `ErrorException`/`TypeError` on malformed wire payloads — same guard style as `ProviderUsageData`/`PricingData`.
- **Admin access (`EnsureUserIsAdmin` + `user:make-admin` + `AdminUserSeeder`):** Middleware aborts 403 unless `is_admin`; `php artisan user:make-admin {email}` promotes an existing user; `AdminUserSeeder` is opt-in (`db:seed --class=AdminUserSeeder`) and refuses to run without `SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL`/`SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` env vars — no hardcoded admin credentials.
- **Date-range validation (`UsageReportRequest`):** `start_date`/`end_date` are UTC `Y-m-d`, `≤ today`, `end ≥ start`; a `withValidator` hook caps the inclusive span at `MAX_RANGE_DAYS` (92) matching Pixelforge's own `date_range_too_long` limit. Default = last 30 days ending today (matching the provider default window).
- **Aggregation (`App\Actions\Admin\UsageReportAction`):** Two `DB::table` queries (no model hydration): succeeded generations grouped by `date(completed_at)` — portable across SQLite/Postgres — and per-user totals via `users` join. Provider cost truth is `actual_provider_cost`; profit = `user_spend - provider_cost` exactly in nanodollars. Failed/queued/processing rows are excluded by the `status` + `completed_at` filters.
- **Reconciliation:** Local provider cost is compared per-day and in total against the provider's `GET /v1/usage` report for the same UTC range; `delta = local_provider_cost - reported_cost` (positive = we recorded more than Pixelforge billed). Days present on either side are unioned and sorted.
- **Presentation (`App\Support\UsageReportPresenter`):** Every money figure ships as both an exact 9-decimal USD string (`*_usd`, provider wire format) and a display string (`*_display`), so no float ever crosses the boundary. `Admin/Report.vue` renders a date-range form (via `router.get` on the Wayfinder `report` route), an effective-range banner, `InputError` under both date inputs, six total cards, a daily reconciliation table, and a per-user table.
- **Navigation (`AppSidebar.vue`):** Adds a conditional "Usage Report" nav item (ChartColumn icon) shown only when `page.props.auth.user.is_admin === true`; `is_admin` added to the `User` type.
- **Route:** `GET /admin/report` named `admin.report` inside the `auth`/`verified` + `EnsureUserIsAdmin` group.

### Review fixes (round 2)

- **Privilege-escalation hardening:** `ProfileValidationRules::profileRules()` (shared by `CreateNewUser` registration and `ProfileUpdateRequest`) now declares `'is_admin' => ['prohibited']` — a submitted `is_admin` key is a hard 422 on both surfaces. `#[Fillable]` already excluded the column, so mass-assignment was never possible; this makes the rejection explicit and tested.
- **Deletion retention:** `generations.user_id` and `wallets.user_id` are now nullable (migration). `User::deleting` nulls `user_id` on the user's generations + wallet and scrubs prompt/reference-image fields, so report financials survive account deletion; the per-user section surfaces an aggregate "(deleted user)" row for orphaned spend. `WalletService::walletForGeneration` resolves an orphaned generation's wallet through its hold transaction so settlement/refunds still post to the anonymized wallet.
- **Billed vs collected:** `actual_user_cost` is the charge, not guaranteed cash — `settleGeneration` caps captures at remaining balance. Day/user/total rows now report `user_spend` (billed), `collected` (net ledger debit for succeeded generations), and `uncollected` (billed − collected) so shortfalls can't overstate profit.
- **Strict provider payload:** `UsageReportData::fromArray` now requires `data` (array of objects) and `total` (with `generations`/`cost_usd`) — a provider response missing those keys throws `malformed_response` instead of rendering a false "zero billing" report.
- **Seeder live-session fix:** `AdminUserSeeder` refuses to run when the email is already registered (points to `php artisan user:make-admin`) instead of `updateOrCreate`-promoting an account that may hold live sessions.
- **Report UX:** date inputs sync from the applied `range` prop after navigation, `InputError` renders backend validation failures under each input, and an effective-range banner states the window being shown.

### Review fixes (round 3)

- **Deletion/creation race:** `ProfileController::destroy` now locks the `users` row and deletes inside one transaction; `CreateGenerationAction` takes the same `lockForUpdate` in TX1 and `firstOrFail`s — a submission that loses the race aborts 404 before any row, hold, or provider call exists, and one that wins is scrubbed by the deletion it serialized against.
- **Orphan image redaction:** `handleSucceeded` writes `image_url`/`image_url_expires_at` only when `user_id` is set — late success events on retained generations still record usage/costs and settle the hold on the anonymized wallet, but no media reattaches.
- **Form state on rejected range:** `Report.vue` moved input syncing from a `watch` on `range` into `router.get`'s `onSuccess`, so a 422 redirect can no longer overwrite in-progress edits with the echoed range.
- **Rollback guard:** the nullable-`user_id` migration's `down()` counts anonymized rows first and throws actionable guidance instead of a raw NOT-NULL constraint failure.
- **Ledger subquery scoping:** `netDebitSubquery` joins generations with the succeeded-status and `completed_at` range filters, so the report no longer aggregates ledger rows outside the window.
- **Metadata fallback hardening:** `findGeneration`'s `local_generation_id` fallback now requires `provider_id IS NULL` — a signed event can only claim a generation never bound to a provider id, closing the recycled-id attach surface.

## Epic 06 — Wallets & Balances (Merged)

- **`App\Services\WalletService`:** Single owner of every wallet balance mutation — `ensureWallet`, `purchase`, `holdForGeneration`, `settleGeneration`, `releaseForGeneration`. Each runs inside `DB::transaction` (nesting safely into caller transactions), locks the `wallets` row with `lockForUpdate()`, and writes an immutable `transactions` ledger row whose `balance_after` is the post-mutation balance. All amounts are integer nanodollars.
- **Insufficient-funds blocking (`holdForGeneration` + `CreateGenerationAction`):** The hold check now happens inside the wallet row lock in TX1 — `balance < estimated_max_user_cost` throws `ValidationException` (key `balance`), rolling back the pre-created `Generation` row *before* `POST /v1/generations` is ever called. Concurrent submissions serialize on the lock and cannot overdraft. This is a deliberate contract change: Epic 03 created unfunded `reserved_amount = 0` generations; Epic 06 rejects them (three pre-existing tests updated to fund wallets).
- **Settlement refactor (`ApplyGenerationStateAction`):** `handleSucceeded` delegates to `settleGeneration` (release `reserved - actual` surplus, or capture wallet-capped shortfall), `handleFailed` delegates to `releaseForGeneration` (100% refund). `CreateGenerationAction::failAndRelease` reuses `releaseForGeneration`. No behavioral change — same ledger types/directions/descriptions, same idempotency.
- **Shared wallet prop (`HandleInertiaRequests`):** `wallet: { balance, balance_display } | null` on every authenticated Inertia render, plus `flash.status` for purchase confirmations. Typed in `resources/js/types/global.d.ts`.
- **Credits page (`WalletController` + `Credits/Index.vue`):** `GET /credits` paginates the polymorphic ledger (15/page, `with('transactionable')`) through `TransactionPresenter::ledgerRow` (signed amount, `balance_after`, direction, type, linked generation URL). The ledger is filterable by `?type=` (purchase/hold/capture/release) and `?direction=` (credit/debit) and sortable by `?sort=` (created_at/amount/balance_after, `-` prefix = desc) — the UI exposes type + direction chip rows and clickable column headers, all preserving query state through pagination. `POST /credits` validates `amount_usd` as a strict decimal string (`regex` + parsed `> 0` + ≤ $1,000 cap) → `WalletService::purchase` writes a `credit`/`purchase` row; throttled `30,1`. UI offers `+$5.00`/`+$10.00`/`+$25.00` presets + custom USD input.
- **Query pipeline (`App\Concerns\UsesPipeline` + `App\Filters\*`):** Index endpoints run their query through `Illuminate\Pipeline\Pipeline` — `GenerationController::index` (`StatusFilter` + `Sort` on `created_at`), `WalletController::index` (`TypeFilter`, `DirectionFilter`, `Sort` on `created_at`/`amount`/`balance_after`). Filters take resolved inputs via constructor (`tryFrom` + `is_string` guards live in the controller); `Sort` whitelists columns and falls back to `-created_at`, exposing `current()` for the `filters` prop. Generations index gains an `?sort=created_at` (oldest) ↔ `-created_at` (newest, default) toggle.
- **Status counts without hydration:** `GenerationPresenter::statusCounts` uses `DB::table('generations')` + `pluck` — aggregates straight from the query builder, no model hydration.
- **Mocked HTTP in tests:** `tests/Pest.php` registers a global `Http::preventStrayRequests()` in `beforeEach` — any outbound call that misses a test's `Http::fake` patterns throws instead of silently hitting the network.
- **Conventions:** all `str_*`/`mb_*` calls that have an `Illuminate\Support\Str` equivalent converted app-wide + tests (`Str::endsWith`, `Str::startsWith`, `Str::replace`, `Str::repeat`, `Str::padRight/padLeft`, `Str::length`); `strlen` kept only where byte length matters (`inet_pton` binary).
- **Studio insufficient-funds UX (`Generations/Create.vue`):** Wallet balance badge in the header; when `estimate.user_max_nanodollars > wallet.balance` (or the server returns a `balance` error) a destructive alert shows the shortfall + a "Buy credits" link, and the submit button is disabled — client-side hint only, the backend check remains authoritative.
- **Navigation (`AppSidebar.vue`, `Dashboard.vue`):** New `Credits` nav item (Coins icon) + "Buy credits" link on the dashboard wallet card; all via generated Wayfinder routes.
- **Test helpers:** `seedPricingCacheAndKey` moved to `tests/Pest.php` so it resolves when running a single test file.

## Epic 05 — History, Detail & Dashboard UI (Merged)

- **History Index (`GenerationController::index` + `Generations/Index.vue`):** `GET /generations` returns only the authenticated user's generations, ordered newest-first, paginated 12/page (`withQueryString()`), filterable by `?status=` (backed-enum `tryFrom` — invalid values fall back to All). Per-status counts power the filter tabs. The page smart-polls with `usePoll(4000, { only: ['generations'] })`, starting/stopping automatically based on whether any visible row is `queued`/`processing`.
- **Detail Page (`GenerationController::show` + `Generations/Show.vue`):** `GET /generations/{generation}` (implicit binding) renders the full image (with expired-URL fallback), prompt + reference images, lifecycle timestamps, estimated vs. actual token usage, `rates_snapshot`, and estimated min–max vs. actual cost — `Free ($0.00)` on failed generations. Polls `{ only: ['generation'] }` while pending.
- **On-Demand Refresh (`GenerationController::refresh`):** `POST /generations/{generation}/refresh` (throttled `30,1`) polls `GET /v1/generations/{provider_id}` and runs the result through the same `ApplyGenerationStateAction` settlement path as webhooks — idempotent via `GenerationState::canTransitionTo()`. `provider_id === null` → `back()->withErrors(['provider' => ...])`; provider failures surface through the centralized `ProviderException` renderer (no controller `try/catch`).
- **Authorization (`GenerationPolicy`):** `view`/`refresh` abilities enforced via `Gate::authorize` in the controller — cross-user access returns `403`. Index/show are owner-scoped by `where('user_id', ...)`.
- **Presentation (`App\Support\GenerationPresenter`):** Single serializer shared by index/show/dashboard — summary and detail shapes, HTTPS-only `image_url` sanitization (provider data is untrusted), `image_expired` flag, `Money::formatDisplay` for all costs, and grouped per-status counts. The detail payload also reports `wallet_net_debit_display` (holds + captures − releases from the ledger) separately from `actual_user_cost_display` (billed cost) since under-funded wallets can be debited less than billed.
- **Strict Success Payloads (`ProviderGenerationData::fromArray`):** A `succeeded` status now requires `usage` + `image_url`; incomplete success payloads throw `InvalidArgumentException` — acknowledged on webhooks, a provider error on refresh — rather than settling a $0 terminal state that would swallow the later complete payload.
- **SSR-Safe Polling:** `usePoll` registers with `router.poll()` synchronously in setup and only cleans up in `onUnmounted`, which `renderToString` never runs — so both pages create the `router.poll` registration inside `onMounted` and destroy it in `onUnmounted` (no registration ever exists on the SSR render server), with a `hasPending` watcher toggling `start()/stop()`.
- **Dashboard (`DashboardController` + `Dashboard.vue` rewrite):** Replaces `Route::inertia` with a real controller serving wallet balance, status counts, and the 5 most recent generation summaries.
- **Navigation (`AppSidebar.vue`):** Adds a `History` item via the generated `index()` Wayfinder route; all links use named/Wayfinder routes — no hard-coded URLs.

## Epic 04 — Webhooks, Signature Verification & Idempotency (Merged)

- **Signature Verification (`PixelforgeProvider::verifyWebhookSignature`):** Parses `Pixelforge-Signature` (`t=<ts>,v1=<hex>`), enforces a 300s replay window, and uses constant-time `hash_equals` on `"{$timestamp}.{$rawPayload}"` via PHP 8.4 `array_any`.
- **CSRF & Auth Exemption (`bootstrap/app.php`, `routes/web.php`):** `POST /webhooks/pixelforge` is outside `auth` middleware and excluded from CSRF verification.
- **Crash-Safe Idempotency (`PixelforgeWebhookController`):** Uses `insertOrIgnore` on `webhook_events.provider_event_id` (`UNIQUE`), locks the `WebhookEvent` row inside `DB::transaction`, skips if `processed_at !== null`, matches `Generation` by `provider_id` or `metadata.local_generation_id`, calls `ApplyGenerationStateAction`, and sets `processed_at` in the same transaction. Unknown events, `ping`, and orphan events are preserved and acknowledged with `204`.
- **Stale Reconciliation (`ReconcileStaleGenerationsCommand` + `routes/console.php`):** Scheduled every 5 minutes (`withoutOverlapping()`) to poll `GET /v1/generations/{id}` for stale `queued`/`processing` rows. Provider errors are classified deliberately: `404` fails immediately (`reconciliation_not_found`), still-pending past `--max-age` (60m) times out (`reconciliation_timeout`), and transient errors (5xx/connection/malformed) are reported and retried next run until `--hard-max-age` (24h) bounds the hold (`reconciliation_unreachable`). Transient errors never permanently fail a generation within the retry window.
- **Defensive Payload Parsing (`ProviderGenerationData::fromArray`):** Required semantic fields (`id`, `status`, `image_url`) are type-validated and reject with `InvalidArgumentException` (wrapped as `ProviderException` 502 `malformed_response`, acknowledged on webhooks / transient on polls). Optional informational fields — all four timestamps and `error.code`/`error.message` — tolerate malformed values as `null`, so a bad `completed_at` can neither poison a webhook mid-transaction nor fail an already-accepted `queued` submission.
- **Webhook Data Retention:** `webhook_events.payload` contains prompt text and image URLs, so processed events are mass-pruned daily after 30 days (`model:prune` in `routes/console.php`, unprocessed events are kept for crash recovery), and `User::deleting` purges a deleted account's webhook events before `generations.user_id` cascades.

## Epic 03 — Generation Lifecycle & Create Studio UI (Merged)

- **Centralized Error Handling (`bootstrap/app.php` + `ProviderException`):** `ProviderException` is rendered centrally in `bootstrap/app.php` (JSON `{ message, error_code }` for `expectsJson()`, or `back()->withErrors(['provider' => ...])` for Inertia) with structured `context()`. Controllers have zero `try/catch` blocks.
- **Two-Transaction Boundary (`CreateGenerationAction`):** TX1 locks `wallets`, pre-creates `Generation` (`status: Queued`, `idempotency_key`), and reserves `estimated_max_user_cost` if funded *before* calling `POST /v1/generations` (so racing webhooks match via `metadata.local_generation_id`). Outbound HTTP retries `503`/timeouts with the same `Idempotency-Key`. TX2 reconciles `202` or transitions to `Failed` + releases 100% of hold on error.
- **Idempotent State Machine (`ApplyGenerationStateAction`):** Uses `lockForUpdate()` + `GenerationState::canTransitionTo()` out-of-order guard; computes exact nanodollar costs and settles surplus/shortfall on `Succeeded` or refunds 100% on `Failed`.
- **SSRF Guard (`SafeExternalUrl`):** Validates `http`/`https` schemes and rejects `localhost`, `.local`, `.internal`, and private/reserved IP ranges on `reference_images.*`.
- **Create Studio UI (`resources/js/pages/Generations/Create.vue`):** Inertia v3 + Wayfinder + Tailwind v4 with debounced live cost estimate, Unicode char counter, 0–4 reference URLs, and inline provider error display.

## Epic 02 — Pricing Pipeline (Merged)

- **`ImageGenerationProvider` Binding (`AppServiceProvider`):** Resolves `PixelforgeProvider` from `config('services.image_provider.driver')` (default `pixelforge`). Remaining provider methods (`createGeneration`, `getGeneration`, `getUsage`, `verifyWebhookSignature`) intentionally throw `LogicException` until Epics 03, 04, and 07.
- **`PixelforgeProvider::getPricing()`:** Fetches `GET /v1/pricing` with retry on transient `ConnectionException`/5xx, caches for 5 minutes (`pixelforge:pricing`), and hydrates `PricingData`.
- **`PricingCalculator` & `CostEstimateData`:** Uses `mb_strlen(..., 'UTF-8')` for character-based token estimation, computes `intdiv($tokens * $ratePerMillionNanodollars, 1_000_000)` in integer nanodollars (zero floats), and applies exact half-up 25% markup (`Money::applyMarkup`).
- **Live Estimate Endpoint:** `POST /generate/estimate` (`EstimateGenerationController`, `EstimateGenerationRequest`, throttled `60,1`).

## Epic 01 — Foundation (Merged)

- **Money Representation (`App\Support\Money`):** All monetary values are stored as signed `BIGINT` **nanodollars** ($10^{-9}$ USD), matching Pixelforge's 9-decimal USD strings (`"0.046125000"`) with zero floating-point arithmetic.
- **Wallets & Polymorphic Ledger:**
  - 1:1 `wallets` table (`user_id` unique, `balance` in nanodollars, `CHECK (balance >= 0)` on PostgreSQL).
  - `User::created` auto-provisions a zero-balance wallet; `create_wallets_table` migration backfills existing users.
  - `transactions` uses `nullableMorphs('transactionable')`. `transactions_wallet_morph_type_unique` (`wallet_id, transactionable_type, transactionable_id, type`) intentionally treats `NULL` morphs as distinct so users can have multiple `purchase` rows while `hold`/`capture`/`release` per `Generation` are unique.
- **State Machine (`spatie/laravel-model-states`):** `Generation::$status` is cast to `GenerationState` (`Queued -> Processing -> Succeeded | Failed`). Terminal states (`Succeeded`, `Failed`) have zero outgoing transitions. `GenerationStatus` enum is retained for validation/filtering/UI.
- **Provider Abstraction:** `App\Contracts\ImageGenerationProvider` + typed `readonly` DTOs under `app/Data/Pixelforge/`, selected via `IMAGE_PROVIDER` (default `pixelforge`).
- **Prompt Sanitization (`App\Support\PromptSanitizer`):** Strips ASCII control chars and enforces valid UTF-8 / 4,000-char limit while intentionally preserving Pixelforge test keywords (`[fail]`, `[slow]`, `[duplicate]`).
- **Quality Gates:** Pint, Rector (PHP 8.4 + Laravel 13), Larastan Level 7, `vp check`, `vue-tsc --noEmit`, and Pest 5 running against both SQLite and PostgreSQL 17.
